recruitmentDialogue.BillyGreeting: Oh, you almost scared me to death. Wait, too late for that! Anyways, I thought you were another one of those crazy cultists.
recruitmentDialogue.BillyJoinCue: All right. I'll come with you.
recruitmentDialogue.BillyWhatAreYouCue: Technically? A violation of several natural laws. Practically? Still me. Still thinking. Still shooting straighter than most of the living. Look, I get it. I'm not supposed to be up and walking around. I've filed that complaint myself. But until the universe processes the paperwork, I've got things to do.
recruitmentDialogue.BillyWhyHereCue: Same reason as you, I'm guessing. The world's ending, demons are everywhere, and nobody else is doing the job right. I follow Irori. Self-perfection. Discipline. Mastery. Turns out death is just an unexpected training condition. So here I am. Improving. Adapting. Trying not to fall apart, literally or philosophically.
recruitmentDialogue.BillyDangerousCue: To enemies? Absolutely. To you? Not unless you start chanting in Abyssal or sprout extra limbs. I've got standards.
recruitmentDialogue.BillyPlanAnswer: What do you plan to do now?
recruitmentDialogue.BillyPlanCue: Keep moving. Keep improving. Keep putting arrows into things that deserve it. And maybe, eventually, figure out whether this is something to fix or something to master.

bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestStartCue: That's my bow! How did this crazy bitch get it? I left it at the temple of Irori... no. I was holding it. Polished stone, incense, the training hall bell, then nothing until I woke up in a crypt with dirt in my mouth and prayer beads in my ribs.
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestTempleAnswer: Slow down. What is the last thing you remember from the temple?
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestTempleCue: Evening practice. Draw, hold, release. Again. Again. My fingers were split raw, and I was proud of it. Master Kalas said discipline is what remains when terror arrives. Then cold candle-smoke, a hand on my shoulder, and my bow hitting the floor. Or maybe that was me.
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestHosillaAnswer: Hosilla having it means someone carried it from the temple to the Shield Maze.
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestHosillaCue: That's the cheerful arithmetic, yes. A cultist chief didn't find temple property in a barrel of discount blasphemy. Someone took this from me, or from my body, and I very much want to know which version is worse.
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestDisciplineAnswer: The bow still punishes chaotic foes. Irori's discipline survived with you.
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestDisciplineCue: Comforting in the most upsetting possible way. If the bow remembers my vows better than I remember my death, maybe it can point us backward. Not literally, I assume. Though if it starts humming, everyone stay calm.
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestEndAnswer: We'll find out what happened to you.
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestEndCue: Good. Because if my last living day ended at the temple, then my first undead step in that crypt was not an accident. And if someone did this to me, I intend to discuss personal growth with them at arrowpoint.
